name.fil: Bullying and Peer Violence (Pambu-bully at Karahasan ng Kapwa)

lessons.en: Bullying is never the target's fault.
lessons.fil: Hindi kailanman kasalanan ng biktima ang bullying.

lessons.en: Tell a trusted adult; asking for help is not snitching.
lessons.fil: Magsabi sa trusted adult; ang paghingi ng tulong ay hindi pagsusumbong para lang manira.

lessons.en: Be an upstander: don't join in, support the target, and get an adult. Never step into a fight.
lessons.fil: Maging upstander: huwag sumali, suportahan ang biktima, at tumawag ng adult. Huwag pumagitna sa away.

question.fil: Alin ang pinakamagandang paglalarawan sa bullying?

choices.en: Repeated, intentional behavior meant to hurt or control someone who has a hard time defending themselves
choices.fil: Paulit-ulit at sinasadyang pag-uugali para manakit o kontrolin ang taong nahihirapang ipagtanggol ang sarili

choices.en: A friendly joke both people enjoy

choices.fil: Hindi pagkakasundo na naayos nang magalang

explain.en: Bullying is repeated and involves an imbalance of power.
explain.fil: Paulit-ulit ang bullying at may hindi pantay na kapangyarihan.

question.en: What do you call a person who safely speaks up or gets help when they see bullying?
question.fil: Ano ang tawag sa taong ligtas na nagsasalita o humihingi ng tulong kapag may nakikitang bullying?

explain.en: Upstanders help without putting themselves in danger.
explain.fil: Tumutulong ang upstanders nang hindi inilalagay ang sarili sa panganib.

question.en: Bullying is the fault of the person being bullied.
question.fil: Kasalanan ng biktima kung bakit siya binu-bully.

explain.en: No one deserves to be bullied, whatever their differences.
explain.fil: Walang sinumang dapat ma-bully, anuman ang pagkakaiba niya sa iba.

question.en: RA 10627 is also known as the Anti-____ Act of 2013.
question.fil: Ang RA 10627 ay kilala rin bilang Anti-____ Act of 2013.

explain.en: This law requires schools to have policies to prevent and respond to bullying, including online.
explain.fil: Inaatasan ng batas na ito ang mga school na magkaroon ng patakaran para maiwasan at matugunan ang bullying, kasama ang online.

question.en: Match each type of bullying with its example.
question.fil: Itugma ang bawat uri ng bullying sa halimbawa nito.

pairs.en: Spreading rumors or leaving someone out on purpose
pairs.fil: Pagkakalat ng tsismis o sinasadyang hindi pagsali sa isang tao

pairs.en: Posting hurtful messages or photos online
pairs.fil: Pag-post ng nakakasakit na message o litrato online

explain.en: Knowing the types helps you recognize bullying when it happens.
explain.fil: Kapag alam mo ang mga uri, mas madali mong makikilala ang bullying kapag nangyayari ito.

question.en: Name 3 trusted people a student can go to about bullying.
question.fil: Magbigay ng 3 trusted na tao na puwedeng lapitan ng estudyante tungkol sa bullying.

show.en: parent or guardian, teacher or adviser, guidance counselor, principal, school nurse, an older sibling or relative
show.fil: magulang o guardian, teacher o adviser, guidance counselor, principal, school nurse, nakatatandang kapatid o kamag-anak

explain.en: You do not have to handle bullying alone.
explain.fil: Hindi mo kailangang harapin nang mag-isa ang bullying.

question.en: You are added to a group chat that is making fun of a classmate's photo. What should you do?
question.fil: Na-add ka sa group chat na pinagtatawanan ang litrato ng isang kaklase. Ano ang dapat mong gawin?

choices.en: Like the posts so you fit in
choices.fil: I-like ang mga post para makisama

choices.en: Don't like, share, or reply; leave the chat, reach out kindly to the classmate, and tell a trusted adult
choices.fil: Huwag mag-like, mag-share, o mag-reply; umalis sa chat, kumustahin nang mabait ang kaklase, at sabihan ang trusted adult

choices.en: Screenshot it and post it somewhere else
choices.fil: I-screenshot at i-post sa ibang lugar

explain.en: Bullies want an audience. Refusing to join in and getting help takes that away.
explain.fil: Gusto ng bully ng audience. Kapag tumanggi kang sumali at humingi ka ng tulong, nawawala ang audience na iyon.

question.en: Arrange the steps for responding to cyberbullying.
question.fil: Ayusin ang mga hakbang sa pagharap sa cyberbullying.

steps.en: Do not reply to the hurtful messages
steps.fil: Huwag sagutin ang mga nakakasakit na message

steps.en: Take screenshots to save the evidence

steps.fil: Patuloy na mag-report kung nagpapatuloy ito

explain.en: Saved evidence helps adults and platforms take action.
explain.fil: Nakakatulong ang naka-save na ebidensya para makakilos ang adults at ang platform.

scene.en: A classmate quietly tells you they feel hopeless because of bullying and asks you not to tell anyone.
scene.fil: Tahimik na sinabi sa iyo ng isang kaklase na nawawalan na siya ng pag-asa dahil sa bullying, at pinakiusapan kang huwag sabihin kahit kanino.

choices.en: Listen kindly, stay with them, and tell a trusted adult or the guidance counselor right away
choices.fil: Makinig nang mabuti, samahan siya, at sabihan agad ang trusted adult o ang guidance counselor

explain.en: Their safety matters more than a secret. Support is available, including the NCMH crisis line 1553.
explain.fil: Mas mahalaga ang kaligtasan niya kaysa sa sikreto. May tulong na available, kasama ang NCMH crisis line na 1553.
